data.value: Could not start monitoring the clipboard. See error.log for details.

data.name: GuideHeading
data.value: PlainClip is running in the notification area

data.name: GuideHistory
data.value: Show the history. Choose an item with 1–9, or with ↑↓ and Enter, to paste it.

data.name: GuideIntro
data.value: Copy text as usual. PlainClip pastes it without formatting and keeps a short history of recent text in memory.

data.name: GuideNote
data.value: The history is kept only in memory and is cleared when PlainClip exits. To show this window again, right-click the tray icon and choose "How to use".

data.name: GuideNumber
data.value: Paste the history item with that number (1 = most recent) without opening the list.

data.name: GuideNumberOff
data.value: Not used (default). Turn them on in Settings to paste a history item by its number without opening the list.

data.name: GuidePaste
data.value: Paste the text currently on the clipboard without formatting. If an image or file is on the clipboard, nothing is pasted.

data.name: GuidePasteDisabled
data.value: Turned off. You can choose a key in Settings.

data.name: HistoryCopyOnlyBar
data.value: There is no window to paste into, so the selected item is copied to the clipboard.

data.name: HistoryEmpty
data.value: No history yet. Copied text will appear here.

data.name: HistoryHintCopy
data.value: Enter Copy · Del Delete · Esc Close

data.name: HistoryHintPaste
data.value: Enter Paste · Del Delete · Esc Close

data.name: HookFailedFormat
data.value: Could not start monitoring the keyboard (error {0}). Pressing a key twice to paste is not available. Try "Reset key monitoring" in the tray icon menu, or switch to a shortcut in Settings. Copying from the history list and Ctrl+V still work.

data.name: HotkeyDuplicateFormat
data.value: This shortcut ({0}) cannot be used. Another PlainClip function already uses it.

data.name: HotkeyInUseFormat
data.value: This shortcut ({0}) cannot be used. Another app or Windows is using it.

data.name: HotkeysFailedFormat
data.value: These shortcuts cannot be used: {0}. Choose different keys in Settings.

data.name: NoticeCopiedOnly
data.value: The plain text is on the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V where you want to paste it.

data.name: NoticeElevated
data.value: The target window is running as administrator, so PlainClip may not be able to paste into it. If nothing was pasted, press Ctrl+V.

data.name: NoticeEmpty
data.value: The text on the clipboard is empty.

data.name: NoticeClipboardChanged
data.value: The clipboard changed before pasting, so nothing was pasted. Please try again.

data.name: NoticeFailed
data.value: Could not use the clipboard. Please try again.

data.name: NoticeFiles
data.value: No text to paste (files are on the clipboard).

data.name: NoticeNoText
data.value: No text to paste (an image or other non-text content is on the clipboard).

data.name: NoticeTooLong
data.value: The text is too long to remove its formatting (up to 1,000,000 characters).

data.name: NoticeUnavailable
data.value: Could not read the clipboard (another app is using it).

data.name: RestartFailed
data.value: Could not restart PlainClip. Please exit it and start it again.

data.value:

Restart PlainClip now?

data.value: The numbers match the history list (1 = most recent). While in use, these keys no longer work in other apps. On many European keyboard layouts, Ctrl+Alt works as AltGr and is used to type characters.

data.name: SettingsPasteNote
data.value: Pastes the text currently on the clipboard. Nothing is pasted when an image or a file is copied.

data.name: SettingsPressKey
data.value: Click the box and press the keys to assign.

data.name: SettingsSameAsNumberFormat
data.value: × {0} is the same as a number shortcut.

data.name: SettingsSameAsOtherFormat
data.value: × {0} is the same as the other function.

data.name: SettingsShortcutNote
data.value: Click a shortcut box and press keys to check right away whether the combination is free. Only overlaps with global shortcuts of other apps and Windows can be detected; overlaps with shortcuts that work only inside an app (for example Ctrl+Alt+V in Excel) cannot.

data.name: ShortcutBoxToolTip
data.value: Click here, then press keys (Backspace / Delete to clear).
